subject.title: feat(ios): harvest shared chat capabilities — verbosity, trace toggle, live talk level, sessions entry

question: Should iOS intentionally use the existing `openclaw.webchat.showAssistantTrace` preference with default-on behavior, or should the platform own a separately scoped preference?
rationale: The patch makes a cross-client persisted-preference contract visible in another native client; source-level correctness cannot determine the intended long-term user-setting semantics.

options.title: Use the shared preference
options.body: Confirm that iOS should follow the existing key and default, then merge after real iOS behavior proof is attached.

options.title: Scope the iOS preference
options.body: Use an iOS-specific setting if platform-local control is the intended product contract, with clear migration and default behavior.

recommendation.title: Use the shared preference
recommendation.body: Confirm that iOS should follow the existing key and default, then merge after real iOS behavior proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The nearest merged precedent and the current iOS host-wiring proposal both originate from this native-chat area contributor.
